s: puM, (sfj + GaY .) svaBAvaH । nirmmokzaH । (yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 162 । 35 । “rAjamArge gavAM maDye DAnyamaDye ca DarmmiRaH । nopasevanti rAjendra sargaM mUtrapurIzayoH ॥”) niScayaH । (yaTA, raGuH । 3 । 51 । “gfhARa SastraM yadi sarga eza te na Kalvanirjitya raGuM kftI BavAn ॥”) aDyAyaH । (yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 6 । 559 । “nAtisvalpA nAtidIrGAH sargA azwADikA iha ॥”) sfzwiH । ityamaraH । 3 । 3 । 22 ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 1 । 29 । “hiMsrAhiMsre mfdukrUre DarmmADarmmAvftAnfte । yadyasya so'daDAt sarge tattasya svayamAviSat ॥” saMsAraH । yaTA, gItAyAm । 5 । 19 । “ihEva tErjitaH sargo yezAM sAmye sTitaM manaH ॥”) mohaH । utsAhaH । iti medinI ॥ anumatiH । iti hemacandraH ॥ * ॥ sargavivaraRaM yaTA, -- “avyAkftaguRakzoBAt mahatastrivfto'hamaH । BUtasUkzmendriyArTAnAM samBavaH sarga ucyate ॥” iti SrIBAgavatam ॥ navaDAsargo yaTA, -- “sargo navaviDastasya prAkfto vEkftastu yaH । kAladravyaguRErasya triviDaH pratisaMkramaH ॥ Adyastu mahataH sargo guRavEzamyamAtmanaH । dbitIyastvahamo yatra dravyajYAnakriyodayaH ॥ BUtasargastftIyastu tanmAtro dravyaSaktimAn । caturTa EndriyaH sargo yastu jYAnakriyAtmakaH ॥ vEkAriko devasargaH paYcamo yanmayaM manaH । zazWastu tamasaH sargo yastvabudDikftaH praBoH ॥ zaqime prAkftAH sargA vEkftAnapi me SfRu । rajoBAjo Bagavato lIleyaM harimeDasaH ॥ saptamo muKyasargastu zaqviDastasTuzAYca yaH । vanaspatyozaDilatAtvaksArA vIruDo drumAH । utsrotasastamaHprAyA antaHsparSA viSeziRaH । tiraScAmazwamaH sargaH so'zwAviMSadviDo mataH ॥ avido BUritamaso GrARajYA hfdyavedinaH । gOrajo mahizaH kfzRaH SUkaro gavayo ruruH ॥ dbiSaPAH paSavaSceme aviruzwraSca sattama । Karo'Svo'Svataro gOraH SaraBaScamarI taTA ॥ ete cEkaSaPAH kzattaH SfRu paYcanaKAn paSUn । SvA SfgAlo vfko vyAGro mArjAraH SaSaSallakO ॥ siMhaH kapirgajaH kUrmmo goDA ca makarAdayaH । kaNkagfDravakaSyenaBAsaBallakavarhiRaH ॥ haMsasArasacakrAhvakAkolUkAdayaH KagAH । arvvAksrotastu navamaH kzattarekaviDo nfRAm ॥ rajo'DikAH karmmaparA duHKe ca suKamAninaH । vEkftAstraya evEte devasargaSca sattama ॥ vEkArikastu yaH proktaH kOmArastUBayAtmakaH । devasargaScAzwaviDo vibuDAH pitaro'surAH ॥ ganDarvvApsarasaH sidDA yakzarakzAMsi cAraRAH । BUtapretapiSAcASca vidyADrAH kinnarAdayaH ॥ daSEte vidurAKyAtAH sargAste viSvasfkkftAH । ataH paraM pravakzyAmi vaMSaM manvantarARi ca ॥ evaM rajaHplutaH srazwA kalpAdizvAtmaBUrhariH । sfjatyamoGasaMkalpa AtmEvAtmAnamAtmanA ॥” iti ca SrIBAgavate । 3 । 10 । 14-26 ॥ (vizRuH । iti mahABAratam । 13 । 141 । 30 ॥ SivaH । iti ca tatrEva । 13 । 17 । 148 ॥)
v: pu॰ sfja--GaY । 1 svaBAve 2 sfzwO 3 nirmohe kAvyAdeH 4 paricCede “sargo'yamAdirgataH” iti nEzaDam । 5 niScaye amaraH “yadi sarga eza te” iti raGuH । 6 mokze 7 utsAhe medi॰ 8 anumato hemaca॰ । sfzwirUpaH sargaSca navaviDaH BAga॰ 3 । 10 a॰ ukto yaTA “sargo navaviDastasya prAkfto vEkftastu yaH । kAladravyaguRErasya triviDaH pratisaMkramaH । Adyastu mahataH sargo guRavEzaByamAtmanaH । dvitIyastvahamo yatra dravyajYAnakriyodayaH । BUtasargastftIyastu tanmAtro dravyaSaktimAn । caturTa EndriyaH sarto yastu jYAnakriyAtmakaH । vEkAriko devasargaH paYcamo yanmayaM manaH । zazWastu tamasaH sargo yastvabudDikftaH praBoH । zaqime prAkftAH sargA vEkftAnapi me SfRu । rajoBAjo Bagavato lIleyaM harimeDasaH । saptamo muKyasargastu zaqviDastasTuzAYca yaH । vanaspatyozaDilatAtvaksArAvIruDo drumAH । utsrotasastamaHprAyA antaHsparSAviSeziRaH । tiraScAmazwamaH sargaH so'zwaviMSadviDo mataH । avido BUritamaso GrARajYA hfdyavedinaH । gOrajo mahizaH kfzRaH SUkaro navayo ruruH । dviSaPAH paSavaSceme aviruzwraSca sattama! । Karo'Svo'Svataro gOraH SaraBaScamarI taTA । ete cEkaSaPAH kzattaH! SfRu paYcanaKAn paSUn । SvA SfgAlo vfko vyAvro mArjAraH SaSaSallakO । siMhaH kapirgajaH kUrmo goDA ca makarAdayaH । kaNkagfDravakaSyenaBAsaBallUkavarhiRaH । haMsasArasacakrANgakAkolUkAdayaH KagAH । arvAksrotAstu navamaH kzattarekaviDo nfRAm । rajo'DikAH karmaparA duHKe ca suKamAninaH । vEkftAstraya evEte devasargASca sattama! । vEkArikastu yaH prokta kOmArastUBayAtmakaH । devasargaScAzwaviDo vibuDAH pitaro'surAH । ganDarvApmarasaH sidDA yakzarakzAMsi cAraRAH । BUtapretapiSAcASca vidyADrAH kinnarAdayaH । daSEte vidurAKyAtA sargAste viSvasfkkftAH” ।
m: सर्ग m. (ifc. f(आ). ; fr. √ सृज्) letting go, discharging, voiding (as excrement), MBh.; R.
starting (a race-horse), racing, RV.
a herd let loose from a stable, any troop or host or swarm or multitude, ib.; Rājat.
a draught of air, gust of wind, RV.
a stream, gush, rush, downpour (of any fluid; acc. with √ कृ, ‘to cast or strike down’, RV.)
a dart, shot, ib.

emission or creation of matter, primary creation (as opp. to प्रतिसर्ग ‘secondary creation’), creation of the world (as opp. to its प्रलय ‘dissolution’, and स्थिति, ‘maintenance in existence’; 9 different creations are enumerated in BhP. iii, 10, 13; आ सर्गात्, ‘from the creation or beginning of the world’; सर्गे ‘in the created world’), Up.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
a created being, creature (with दैव ‘a divine creation’, ‘a god’), Ragh.
begetting, procreation, MBh.
origin, BhP.
offspring, a child, ib.
nature, natural property, disposition, tendency, Bhag. v, 19
effort, exertion, resolution, resolve, will, Ragh.; Śiś.
a section, chapter, book, canto (esp. in an epic poem)
assent, agreement, L.
fainting (= मोह), L.
implement of war, MBh. xi, 2165 (Nīlak.)
= विसर्ग, the aspiration at the end of a word, Cat.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
of a son of Rudra, Pur.
सर्ग &c. See p. 1182, col. 3.
a: सर्गः — [सृज्-घञ्] 1 Relinquishment, abandonment. --2 Creation; अस्याः सर्गविधौ प्रजापतिरभूच्चंद्रो नु कांतिप्रदः V. 1. 8. --3 The creation of the world; Ku. 2. 6; R. 3. 27. --4 Nature, the universe. --5 Natural property, nature. --6 Determination, resolve; गृहाण शस्त्रं यदि सर्ग एष ते R. 3. 51; 14. 42; Śi. 19. 38. --7 Assent, agreement. --8 A section, chapter, canto (as of a poem). --9 Rush, onset, advance (of troops). --10 Voiding of excrement. --11 N. of Śiva. --12 Fainting, swoon (मोह). --13 Ved. A horse. --Comp. --क्रमः the order of creation. --बंधः a great poem having several cantos, a Mahākāvya; सर्गबंधो महाकाव्यं S. D.

s: puM, (sargEraDyAyErbbanDo yasya .) mahAkAvyam । iti BUriprayogaH ॥ tallakzaRaM yaTA, -- “sargabanDo mahAkAvyamucyate tasya lakzaRam । ASIrnamazkriyA vastunirddeSo vApi tanmuKam ॥ itihAsakaTodBUtamitaradvA tadASrayam । caturvvargaPalAyattaM caturodAttanAyakam ॥ nagarArRavaSElarttucandrArkodayavarRanEH । udyAnasalilakrIqAmaDupAnaratotsavEH ॥ vipralamBErvivAhESca kumArodayavarRanEH । mantradUtaprayARAjinAyakAByudayErapi ॥ alaNkftamasaMkziptaM rasaBAvanirantaram । sargEranativistIrREH SravyavfttEH susanDiBiH ॥ sarvvatra BinnavfttAntErupetaM lokaraYjanam । kAvyaM kalpAntarasTAyi jAyate sadalaNkfti ॥” iti daRqI ॥
v: pu॰ banDa--BAve GaY sargErbanDaH 3 ta॰ “kfdaBihitaBAvo dravyavat prakASate” iti nyAyAt sargabanDasya karmaparatA na karmaRi GaY taTaHtve mahAkAvyaviSezaRatayA klIvatApatteH । mahAkAvye tallakzaRaM mahAkAvyaSabde'nuktatvAt atra darSyate sA॰ da॰ “sargabanDo mahAkAvyaM tatrEko nAyakaH suraH । sadvaMSaH kzatriyo vApi DIrodAttaguRAnvitaH । ekavaMSaBavA BUpAH kulajA bahavo'pi vA । SfNgAravIraSAntAnAmekA'NgI rasa izyate । aNgAni sarve'pi rasAH sarve nAwakasanDayaH । itihAsodBavaM vfttamanyadvA sajjanASrayam । catvArastasya vargAH syustezvekaYca PalaM Bavet । AdO namaskriyASIrvA vastunirdeSa eva vA । kvacinnindA KalAdInAM satAYca guRakIrttanam । ekavfttamayEH padyEravasAne'nyavfttakEH । nAtisvalpA nAtidIrGAH sargA azwADikA iha । nAnAvfttamayaH kvApi sargaH kaScana dfSyate । sargAnte BAvisargasya kaTAyAH sUcanaM Bavet । sanDyAsUryendurajanIpradozaDvAntavAsarAH । prAtarmaDyAhnamfgayASElarttuvanasAgarAH । samBogavipralamBO ca munisvargapurADvarAH । raRaprayARopayamamantraputrodayAdayaH । varRanIyA yaTAyogaM sANgopANgA amI iha । kavervfttasya vA nAmnA nAyakasyetarasya vA । nAmAsya sargopAdeyakaTayA sarganAma tu” ।
m: सर्ग—बन्ध m. ‘chapter-construction’, any poem or composition divided into sections or chapters (esp. a Mahā-kāvya or great poem), Kāvyād.; Sāh.
सर्ग—कालीन mfn. relating to or happening at the time of creation, Sāṃkhyapr.
सर्गक mfn. producing, effecting, Sarvad.
सर्ग—कर्तृ m. the creator (-त्व n.), Pañcar.
सर्ग—कर्तृ—त्व n.
सर्ग—कृत् m. = -कर्तृ, Hariv.
सर्ग—क्रम m. the order of creation, MW.
सर्ग—प्रलय-कण्टकोद्धार m. N. of wk.
सर्ग—तक्त or सर्ग—प्रतक्त (सर्ग-), mfn. dashing along in rapid motion, hastening, RV.
सर्ग्य See पाणि-स्˚.
